first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: A large blue area above the horizon, lighter near the horizon.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: A pale yellowish-brown mixed grass-and-soil surface with clumps of short grass, patches of bare soil, and fine unevenness.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Brown to grayish-brown vegetation clumps scattered across the ground, with crowns of varying sizes and outer contours.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A brown strip of bare soil crossing the grassland, containing dark and light linear marks extending along the road strip.

entities.name: Curved Ground Mark
entities.identification: Groups of nested dark curved grooves on the bare ground, with lighter ground strips between the grooves.

entities.name: Distant Blue-Gray Band-Shaped Area
entities.identification: In the distant view on the image-left side in frame 0, a long blue-gray band extending along the outer edge of the Dry Grassland and adjacent to the light-colored ground surface.
